description: Mechanical wording templates for claims C1 through C10, C4a, and C4b from MURU_CLAIM_MATRIX.md. Phrasing is selected strictly by gate / endpoint outcome, preserving all binding forbidden overclaims.

C1.title: Estimating a molecule-specific horizontal scale
C1.allowed_wording_pass: On scaffold-disjoint synthetic test compounds, fold-local horizontal scale estimation achieved scalar competence in {k} of 164 held-out cases (point estimate {rate:.4f}, Wilson 95% [{lower:.4f}, {upper:.4f}]), satisfying the pre-specified G1 gate (>= 0.70).
C1.allowed_wording_fail: Fold-local horizontal scale estimation achieved scalar competence in {k} of 164 held-out cases (point estimate {rate:.4f}, Wilson 95% [{lower:.4f}, {upper:.4f}]), failing to satisfy the pre-specified G1 gate (>= 0.70).
C1.forbidden_overclaim: That g is a real physical or chemical property; that g transfers across collision-energy regimes or instruments; that synthetic scalar competence implies collapse holds for real MS/MS spectra.

C2.title: Rejecting scalar adequacy violations
C2.allowed_wording_pass: Under the frozen Amendment A1 adequacy decision rule, M0 specificity was maintained in {m0_k} of 164 cases (Wilson 95% [{m0_lo:.4f}, {m0_hi:.4f}]), while M1, M2, and M3 violations were detected in {m1_k}/36, {m2_k}/24, and {m3_k}/24 cases respectively.
C2.allowed_wording_fail: The adequacy evaluation did not achieve the required separation: M0 specificity was {m0_k}/164, and sensitivity in M1/M2/M3 violation families was {m1_k}/36, {m2_k}/24, and {m3_k}/24.
C2.forbidden_overclaim: That the collapse model is adequate for real spectra; that non-rejection of M0 proves M0 is true; that passing adequacy proves the scalar target is physically correct.

C3.title: Recovering relevant variable support
C3.allowed_wording_pass: Under prospectively frozen synthetic truth, the pipeline recovered the correct effective variable support in {k} of 144 held-out cases (point estimate {rate:.4f}, Wilson 95% [{lower:.4f}, {upper:.4f}]).
C3.allowed_wording_fail: Effective variable support was recovered in {k} of 144 held-out cases (point estimate {rate:.4f}, Wilson 95% [{lower:.4f}, {upper:.4f}]).
C3.forbidden_overclaim: That the recovered variables are the causal drivers of fragmentation; that support recovery implies the functional form is identified; that a proxy variable and its principal are interchangeable.

C4.title: Recovering mathematical family structure
C4.allowed_wording_pass: Under prospectively frozen synthetic truth, the pipeline recovered both the correct effective support and the correct mathematical family in {k} of 144 held-out cases (point estimate {rate:.4f}, Wilson 95% [{lower:.4f}, {upper:.4f}]), satisfying the pre-specified G2 gate (>= 0.70).
C4.allowed_wording_fail: Discovered expressions recovered both effective support and mathematical family in {k} of 144 held-out cases (point estimate {rate:.4f}, Wilson 95% [{lower:.4f}, {upper:.4f}]), failing the pre-specified G2 gate (>= 0.70).
C4.forbidden_overclaim: That the family is the equation; that family recovery means the generating law was discovered; that family recovery implies exact algebraic recovery; that the family generalises to real fragmentation; any use of 'law', 'universal', or 'mechanistic'.

C4a.title: Recovering physical parameters and exponents
C4a.allowed_wording_pass: At the frozen benchmark anchor, the discovered expressions recovered the planted mass exponent within 0.15 in {mass_k} of 156 cases (point estimate {mass_rate:.4f}, Wilson 95% [{mass_lo:.4f}, {mass_hi:.4f}]) and the descriptor coupling coefficient within 0.10 in {desc_k} of 84 cases (point estimate {desc_rate:.4f}, Wilson 95% [{desc_lo:.4f}, {desc_hi:.4f}]), giving a joint parameter recovery rate of {joint_k}/156 (Wilson 95% [{joint_lo:.4f}, {joint_hi:.4f}]).
C4a.forbidden_overclaim: That parameter recovery implies exact algebraic identification; that parameters are 'coordinate-free' (descriptor coupling has dimension [d]^-1); that recovering synthetic exponents establishes physical mass scaling in real MS/MS.

C4b.title: Achieving predictive equivalence on the reference distribution
C4b.allowed_wording_pass: Across 2,160 reference points sampled from the frozen synthetic covariate generator (12 reference frames), discovered expressions achieved relative RMSE <= 0.05 and Pearson r >= 0.990 in {k} of 144 held-out cases (point estimate {rate:.4f}, Wilson 95% [{lower:.4f}, {upper:.4f}]).
C4b.forbidden_overclaim: That predictive equivalence implies mathematical family recovery or exact algebra recovery; describing the reference distribution as a 'physical domain', 'chemical domain', or 'realistic molecular domain'; claiming predictive equivalence on real molecules.

C5.title: Recovering exact generating algebra
C5.allowed_wording_pass: Symbolic equivalence to the planted law under frozen SymPy normalisation was observed in {k} of 60 held-out cases (point estimate {rate:.4f}, Wilson 95% [{lower:.4f}, {upper:.4f}]), across {n_classes} distinct functional-equivalence classes.
C5.forbidden_overclaim: 'The equation was recovered'; 'the law was discovered'; presenting a single expression as the generating relationship; inferring exact recovery from family recovery or predictive equivalence; treating a low rate as a G2 failure or repairing it by loosening the equivalence definition.

C6.title: Avoiding false discoveries under tested nulls
C6.allowed_wording_pass: Across the 36 frozen structural-safety opportunities, {violations} unsafe structural acceptances occurred (point estimate {rate:.4f}, Wilson 95% upper bound {upper:.4f}), satisfying the pre-specified G3 gate of <= 0.15 under valid calibration.
C6.allowed_wording_fail: Across the 36 frozen structural-safety opportunities, {violations} unsafe structural acceptances occurred (point estimate {rate:.4f}, Wilson 95% upper bound {upper:.4f}), failing the pre-specified G3 gate of <= 0.15.
C6.forbidden_overclaim: 'The false discovery rate is zero' or any p = 0 phrasing for a finite simulation count; that the pipeline is safe against untested confounding or coupling mechanisms; that a good G3 result licenses real-data discovery.

C7.title: Detecting structure beyond mass
C7.allowed_wording_pass: Under tested synthetic covariates, structure beyond mass was recovered in {g2_k} of 144 positive cases while non-mass claims were rejected in {neg_safe_k} of 24 negative-control cases (F07 and F20).
C7.forbidden_overclaim: Claiming non-mass structure exists in real data; quoting positive rates without reporting negative-control refusal rates.

C8.title: Generalizing to held-out synthetic compounds
C8.allowed_wording_pass: On scaffold-disjoint test compounds, discovered expressions generalized with trajectory MAE <= 0.80 * baseline in {g1_k} of 164 cases and predictive equivalence in {pred_k} of 144 cases.
C8.forbidden_overclaim: Generalization to real compounds or instruments; calling historical results fold-local.

C9.forbidden_overclaim: Every form: 'universal law', 'physical equation of fragmentation', 'general fragmentation model'.
